import unittest
from atlas.service import DocumentService


class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_document_lifecycle(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        document = service.repository.create("a", {"title": "Welcome"})
        self.assertEqual(document["revision"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(service.list_documents()["items"], [document])
        service.cache.put("a", document, now=0, ttl=10)
        self.assertEqual(service.cached_document("a", now=1), document)

    def test_service_helpers(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        self.assertTrue(service.authorized(["docs:read"], "docs", "read"))
        self.assertEqual(service.storage_key("/srv/data", "docs/a"), "/srv/data/docs/a")
        self.assertEqual(service.dependencies_for({"a": ["b"]}, "a"), ["b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from atlas.repository import ConflictError, Repository


class RepositoryUpdateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mismatched_revisions_leave_document_unchanged(self):
        repository = Repository()
        repository.create("a", {"items": ["original"]})
        repository.update("a", {"items": ["current"]}, expected_revision=1)
        stored = repository.records["a"]
        snapshot = deepcopy(stored)

        for revision in (0, 1, 3, 100):
            with self.subTest(expected_revision=revision):
                with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
                    repository.update(
                        "a", {"items": ["rejected"]}, expected_revision=revision
                    )
                self.assertIs(repository.records["a"], stored)
                self.assertEqual(repository.records["a"], snapshot)

    def test_matching_revision_increments_once_and_isolates_bodies(self):
        repository = Repository()
        repository.create("a", {"items": []})
        body = {"items": [{"title": "updated"}]}

        result = repository.update("a", body, expected_revision=1)

        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "id": "a", "body": {"items": [{"title": "updated"}]}, "revision": 2
        })
        body["items"][0]["title"] = "input mutation"
        self.assertEqual(result["body"]["items"][0]["title"], "updated")
        result["body"]["items"][0]["title"] = "returned mutation"
        self.assertEqual(repository.records["a"]["body"], {
            "items": [{"title": "updated"}]
        })

        next_result = repository.update("a", {"items": []}, expected_revision=2)
        self.assertEqual(next_result["revision"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(repository.records["a"]["revision"], 3)
